title: The Vigenère Cryptogram
description: 🔐 Encrypted USB Drive containing a Vigenère cipher encrypted with key 'KEY' (K=10, E=4, Y=24).
question: Decrypt the cipher text 'KGX' using keyword 'KEY':
hints: Vigenère cipher adds key letter index to plaintext letter index mod 26.
Subtract E(4) from G(6) -> 2 -> C. Subtract Y(24) from X(23 mod 26) -> 19 -> T.
solution: Subtracting key values of 'KEY' from cipher text 'KGX' yields 'ACT'.
